info.name: Compresses an uploaded image and returns the WebP result.

params.name: maxdim
params.description: The maximum dimension (width or height) of the output image.

items.docs:
Compression metrics are returned in response headers: X-Original-Size, X-Compressed-Size,
 X-Processing-Time-Ms, X-Original-Dimensions, X-Output-Dimensions.

info.name: Uploads a file to our system and returns the new file name used internally.

params.name: compress
params.description: When set, forces image compression on or off for this upload, overriding the configured default.

params.name: quality
params.description: WebP quality (1..100) to use when compression runs. Falls back to the configured default when null.

params.name: maxdim
params.description: Maximum width or height in pixels when compression runs. Falls back to the configured default when null.
